description: ignorePaths intentionally overrides the :ignoreModulesAndTests preset from config:recommended: test/ must stay visible so the metadata-test custom manager can update test/cpu_metadata_test.yml and test/cuda_metadata_test.yml

packageRules.description: Automatically merge patch updates for the Python base image. Minor bumps are deliberately excluded: the site-packages path embedded in the cuda stage's LD_LIBRARY_PATH and asserted in test/cpu_test.yml and test/cuda_test.yml is keyed to the Python minor version (python3.12) and needs a coordinated manual update
Group every Python base reference (FROM, base.name labels, metadata tests) into one PR
Group the NVIDIA CUDA runtime wheels into one PR: nvidia-cudnn-cu12 depends on nvidia-cublas-cu12, so the pins move together

Automatically merge minor and patch updates for the pip pins (PyPI retains every release, so a bad automerge is trivially revertible, and the release gate reruns all structure tests plus a functional transcription). Majors stay manual: a cuBLAS major follows the CUDA major CTranslate2 is built against, and a cuDNN major changes the libcudnn soname asserted in test/cuda_test.yml

customManagers.description: Update versions pinned via renovate comments before ARG lines in the Dockerfile
Keep the Python base.name OCI labels in the Dockerfile in sync with the FROM version
Keep the Python base version in the metadata tests in sync with the FROM version
